decisions.reason: The waste-oil-to-energy plant rests most directly on the firm's core energy-from-waste knowledge, where its R&D and university ties let it interpret results and improve the plant, although its absence from the website in 2020–2021 signals reduced emphasis.

The plastic-to-fuel plant is a technically uncertain, newer conversion route that has not been visible since 2018, which suggests the firm could not turn early learning into commercial traction, so its resources are better spent on the core waste-to-energy business and new ventures.
